rule: At least one source records this binomial as an accepted name while at least one other records it as a synonym of a different name. Compared field: `relation` — `accepted` vs `synonym_of` — across sources.

Every source that mentions the binomial calls it a synonym, but they name different accepted parents for it. Compared field: `accepted_name` on the synonym rows — the set of distinct parents claimed across sources has more than one member.

Every source agrees the binomial is a synonym, and they all name the same parent. But that parent is itself contested, so the placement cannot be resolved. Compared field: nothing on this name. The class is inherited from the parent.
